teleplayNote: Named teleplay segments are source material, not a competing issue map. Preserve useful scenes and beats while organizing production under the current nine-issue structure. toneLock: Bright, ordinary 2026 documentary-sitcom realism. Time-displaced people are routine civic reality. Vikings are intelligent and dignified; comedy comes from incompatible systems, New York indifference, and bureaucratic ritual rather than stupidity.
documentaryRule: Mockumentary/documentary language is production style only. No visible documentary crew is acknowledged in-world.
neighborhoodMemoryRule: Assimilation is shown through repetition and local recognition: same merchants, counters, neighbors, public spaces, routines, and incidental relationships. These scenes are not side quests. Recurring civilians remain ordinary city people, not over-written sitcom side characters.
kinBackgroundRule: In early and middle issues, keep the Kin visible but lightly foregrounded: errands, shopping, laundry, snacks, vendors, parks, neighbors, and ordinary participation. Do not explain how well they are adapting until the later reveal/hearing material recontextualizes these seeds.
